evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, chamfered edges, gold band accent: kit-consistent.

top_fixes: Fix shaft normals: either make flutes crisp with weighted/hard edges or remove the shallow flutes so the shaft shades cleanly
If keeping flutes, make them deep enough to read at 64 px
Slightly slim the abacus or add an echinus curve for a less blocky capital
